english: Tell me about him. I need to know more. Please, please tell me.
Why are you so short with me? Do you hate me? Does Urth hate me?!
You're... mourning the passing of Urth, aren't you? That's why you're acting so weird.
I do not hate you, Cleric.
I cannot speak for your god.
That is not the case, Cleric. You do not seem to have understood things correctly.
She goes quiet for a bit, studying you.
I am busy. Maybe later I can speak in detail.
You can feel her pity you. It hurts.
Your innards quiver at her words.
